truth_boundary: This artifact audits current semantics only. It does not grant authority, mark workers live, or implement the downstream freshness fix.

findings.finding: The single evidence stamp uses the newest generated_at among timeline/frontier/allocator, so one fresh source can visually mask another stale source.
findings.required_downstream_semantics: Expose freshness per required source or derive aggregate health from the stalest required source; never call the bundle fresh from the newest member alone.

findings.finding: A failed refresh leaves the previous in-memory tl/fr/al object in place, which is useful last-good behavior, but the rendered data is not labeled with per-source age or last-good/stale state.
findings.required_downstream_semantics: Keep last-good data visible, but carry source age and current fetch failure so stale evidence cannot look current.

findings.finding: Capacity counts LAUNCHED/OBSERVED_WORKING spans for up to 15 minutes as observed workers. Existing liveness law is active <6m, stale suspect 6-10m, replaceable >=10m, so the UI can overstate live capacity.
findings.required_downstream_semantics: Separate fresh/live, stale-suspect and replaceable/old evidence; only fresh durable evidence may contribute to live WC capacity.

B034_freshness_regression: fresh source cannot mask stale required source
failed refresh keeps last-good bytes but marks them stale/error
worker older than active threshold is not counted as live capacity
downstream.implementation_boundary: B018 intentionally does not rewrite the page; implementation/regression belongs to dependency-driven downstream blocks.
